paths.title: Agent of the Unbroken Circle
paths.description: You hunt corruption as part of a sworn circle, turning your oath of enmity into a rallying point for everyone beside you. Spending an action point lets your allies hit your target harder while they flank it, and a critical hit gives nearby allies a chance to shake off what afflicts them. Training in Insight and Society keeps you alert to rot in the shadows, while a radiant halo bolsters saving throws for any group that crowds your quarry.

paths.title: Favored Soul
paths.description: Heaven's blessing awakens within you, rewarding the avenger who keeps fighting at full strength. Your action points can pull an ally back from the brink with a healing surge, and unbroken health hardens every one of your defenses. At 16th level feathered wings let you fly in light or no armor, and you can streak across the battlefield with a radiant charge or a sweeping series of aerial strikes that daze and stun the foes you pass.

paths.title: Fortune Blessed
paths.description: Avandra's favor turns chance itself into a resource you can bank and spend. Natural 1s and 20s earn luck tokens, and a token spent later nudges a roll upward or lets you try it again, while an action point can win you another token through a saving throw. Misfortune's Curse turns an enemy's missed blow into a gift for you, a lucky break can blunt a hit that would have hurt badly, and your daily attack leaves a foe dazed and slowed while you force its saves to be rerolled.

paths.title: Hammer of Judgment
paths.description: You judge the battlefield like a smith working metal, shoving and hammering enemies exactly where your god wants them. Your action point attacks drive hit foes backward, daily attacks leave targets easier to strike, and bloodied creatures can be flung even farther by any forced movement you inflict. Wielding a hammer stretches every push further, and you can answer a rough turn by shrugging off damage or slamming the ground with a thunderous burst that topples nearby enemies.

paths.title: Oathsworn
paths.description: Your word carries the weight of creation, and your Oath of Enmity becomes a binding sentence on the enemy it names. That foe finds you harder to hit, your action point attacks roll twice against every target, and slaying your sworn enemy lets you recover with a healing surge. Weakening strikes, a prayer that lends your allies the same twin rolls, and a daily bond that leaves the target vulnerable round out a path of grim, focused retribution.

paths.title: Serene Initiate
paths.description: Calm discipline guides your blade, and every swing lands as a measured act rather than a flash of anger. Spending an action point on an at-will attack adds a burst of extra damage, while misses against your sworn enemy still draw blood. A cutting encounter strike punishes targets that dare to act, and a stance and a daily attack reward you with sharper results whenever your Oath of Enmity gives you two attack rolls.

paths.title: Soulforged
paths.requirements: Must worship Moradin; Moradin's Resolve Channel Divinity power
paths.description: You are tempered in the white flames of Moradin's forge and carry its fire into every strike. Spending an action point restores a spent Channel Divinity use or an encounter attack, and your weapon can blaze with fire and radiant light at will. A burning blast scorches nearby foes, an interrupt hardens you against danger, and your daily attack makes the ground around you hard to cross while your hits keep burning with extra Wisdom damage.

paths.title: Zealous Assassin
paths.description: You slip through the edges of combat and strike with the swift efficiency of a divine knife in the dark. An action point grants concealment and a short teleport, and combat advantage or a bloodied foe makes your blows land harder. Charging from hiding can let you strike with the upper hand, while a prayer can erase you from an enemy's sight and your signature attack sears a target with radiant fire that leaves it exposed.
